findings.title: 3 charged in scheme to use AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys to steal $129 million
findings.summary_md: The Independent reported that three people were indicted on charges of wire fraud and aggravated identity theft for using artificial intelligence to impersonate corporate executives and attorneys in a scheme to steal about $129 million. The indictment was filed in a U.S. District Court in New York, and the defendants were also charged with money laundering. The defendants are from Spain, the UK, Israel and the United Arab Emirates, according to court documents.

findings.title: 3 charged in scheme to use AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys to steal $129 million
findings.summary_md: CityNews Calgary published the Associated Press report that three people accused of using AI to impersonate corporate executives and attorneys have been indicted on wire fraud and aggravated identity theft charges in a scheme to steal about $129 million. Federal prosecutors in Manhattan unsealed the indictment. The defendants targeted victims including hospital systems, a bank and other companies across multiple countries.
